subject: SLA Accelerator Pack — pricing, uptime credit capping, and 24m commit discount
messages:
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@brightgrid.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightgrid.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial SLA questions + RFI (BrightGrid)

Connor —

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing our procurement slate for Q1 and need clarity on how Redwood structures premium support and uptime credits. A few concrete asks: 

1) Define your uptime tiers and the maximum credit backstop per incident and per quarter. BrightGrid needs to limit indemnity exposure.
2) How do response-time SLAs (P1/P2) map to on-call retainer costs vs. included coverage?
3) If we commit to an annual or multi-year spend, what discount bucket do you apply to premium support / retainer fees?

I've attached a short RFI and our standard procurement terms (both PDFs/XLSX). We're particularly sensitive to two items: (a) a hard cap on credits (we'd prefer a single quarterly cap) and (b) an escalation path that includes a named SE and an executive review within 24 hours for Sev1.

Can we get a high-level option set by EOD Monday? If useful, schedule a 30 min call — afternoons PT work best.

Best,
Sam Walters
Head of Procurement
BrightGrid

Attachments: BrightGrid_SLA_RFI.pdf (pdf), Procurement_Termsheet.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SLA questions + RFI (BrightGrid)

Sam — appreciate the clear asks and the RFI. High level before we dive into the doc: we can offer an "SLA Accelerator Pack" with three flavors that align to your requirements. Attaching a concise options sheet; below is a quick summary so you can triage before the call.

Summary (high level):
- Accelerator Lite — 99.9% uptime, standard incident credits (1x monthly fee cap), included P2 8x5 response, P1 routed within 1 hour (no guaranteed on-call retainer).
- Accelerator Pro — 99.95% uptime, credit cap = 2x monthly fee per incident / 5x per quarter, P1 guaranteed on-call retainer + named SE + executive notification within 24 hours.
- Accelerator Premium — 99.99% uptime, credit cap = 3x monthly fee per incident / 10x per quarter, dedicated escalation retainer, prioritized routing to regional NOC and SE, can include a short-term warm standby for launches.

Discounting note: for committed spend we tier discounts across the entire package (support + reserved capacity). Typical mid-market starting point: 10% for 12m, 15% for 24m, higher for 36m commitments — exact structure depends on reserve sizing.

On the credit cap request: we can include a single quarterly cap (BrightGrid preference) but will need to map that to committed throughput and failover plans (so credits aren't used to subsidize avoidable single-region configuration gaps).

Next steps: I'm attaching the RI-SLA-Accelerator-Options.pdf with sample bundling and ballpark pricing. If any of the three maps tightly to what you need I can run a final quote and pull legal for a quick redline turn. I can do a call Monday 3pm PT if that works.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI-SLA-Accelerator-Options.pdf (pdf)

To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@brightgrid.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:30:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SLA questions + RFI (BrightGrid)

Hi Sam / Connor —

Adding some concrete pricing mechanics here so procurement has something actionable for internal review. Quick bullets: 

- 24-month commitment concession: 15% off premium support retainer fees and 8% off reserved capacity baseline (applies if BrightGrid signs Accelerator Pro or Premium).
- Uptime credit capping: we can include a single quarterly cap equal to 6x the monthly premium-support retainer for Pro, 10x for Premium. For Lite we keep the 1x per month cap (no quarterly aggregation).
- Incident crediting rules: credits are token-based (per-hour degradation × severity multiplier). We will enumerate the formula in the SOW.
- Escalation coverage: named SE + executive review within 24 hours for Sev1 included on Pro/Premium. Premium includes guaranteed warm-standby (optional add-on).

Notes / trade-offs: if BrightGrid wants a lower cap we can tighten the credit formula but will need a higher retainer or a partial committed reserve to offset risk. I attached a quick spreadsheet with the example math and the invoice impact across 12/24/36m scenarios.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/RI-BG-ACCEL-QUOTE (will populate final numbers once we have your package pick).

Happy to hop on Mon 3pm PT with Connor to align to legal redlines.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Customer Success & Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discount_calc.csv (csv)

From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@brightgrid.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial SLA questions + RFI (BrightGrid)

Connor / Neha —

Thanks for the fast follow-up and the clear options. BrightGrid's procurement team and engineering prefers Accelerator Pro as our baseline. A few asks before we sign the 24m: 

- Please circulate a final quote reflecting the 15% support concession + the 8% reserved-capacity concession for 24m (line items separated).
- We will redline the SLA credit caps to propose a hard quarterly ceiling (we'll attach our redline). Please confirm Redwood will accept quarterly caps in principle; engineering wants a defined numeric cap in the SOW (not an open formula).
- We want the DocuSign envelope to be editable so our legal can apply minor redlines before signature.

Attached is a brief redline doc with the specific clause numbers we've changed. If you can have legal take a look and come back by Wed EOD that would help us keep this on the Q1 onboarding plan.

I'll take the Mon 3pm PT slot for a quick walk-through if that helps — dialing in with our CISO and the procurement director.

Best regards,
Sam Walters
Head of Procurement
BrightGrid

Attachments: BrightGrid_Redline_SLA.docx (docx)
